column1: # Ocarina of Time (oot131072): the shader variants filled from the phone on 2026-11-10 (fill_shaders_ohos.py, three runs) that
# the tuned oot-a134 seed has and a seed translated on the PC for the default bind state lacks. oot_seed.py --variants
# translates them again as a second pass. Only the 146 a draw can select are listed: the 182 other phone fills have the
# default variant's answers and are never chosen. 121 vertex shaders (120 read attribute 6 / 7 as uint: character models;
# one a depth texture at 1), 17 pixel shaders (14 a 2D-array texture at 4 / 5 / 6, 3 a uint colour output), 8 compute
# shaders (a 2D-array texture at 0 / 1 / 20). Hashes and parameters only, no shader code.
# variant (key-suffix: the device's suffix hashes the whole bind state)  stage  answers (the .vv row: kind:slot=value;...)
# sha1 of the module in the oot-a134 seed (after the SSA pass), for checking
